# KiTi-Bat

> KiTi-Bat makes hand-eye coordination skills trainers for cricketers, handmade
> in Johannesburg, South Africa. The trainer is a narrow wooden bat with a rubber
> ball attached by an elastic string: the player hits the ball and keeps it going
> on the face of the bat, which builds ball tracking and hand-eye coordination
> without needing a bowler, a net, a partner or space. KiTi-Bat is a registered
> trademark. The business is owned and run by Nico Botha.

## Products

- [KiTi-Bat, 45 cm](https://www.kiti-bats.co.za/kiti-bat): The original hand-eye
  skills trainer. 45 cm long, 7 cm wide, made from American poplar, with a rubber
  ball on an elastic string. **R350 each.** Suits ages 5 to 80. The narrow face
  leaves little margin for error, which is what sharpens the eye.
- [KiTi Junior, 30 cm](https://www.kiti-bats.co.za/kiti-junior): The trainer for
  the youngest players. 30 cm long, 11 cm wide, cut from South African pine
  plywood, with a rubber ball on an elastic string. **R165 each, or two for R300.**
  The shorter length and wider face let a five-year-old get clean contact from the
  first session.
- [Catch-It Trainer](https://www.kiti-bats.co.za/catch-it-trainer): A hand-strung
  rebound net that returns a thrown ball at speed, for catching, fielding and
  reaction work in cricket, netball and tennis. Roughly 900 x 900 mm with an
  adjustable return height. **R2 000.** Accessories: trainer bag R480, bouncer
  R850, indoor adapter R250.

## Ordering

- [Order and prices](https://www.kiti-bats.co.za/order): Full price list, bulk
  rates, delivery and contact details.
- Orders are placed directly by WhatsApp, phone or email — there is no online
  checkout. Payment is by EFT once the total is confirmed.
- Courier is **R50 for bats**, not included in the price, anywhere in South
  Africa. A Catch-It Trainer is R100 to R300 depending on the area. Collection in
  Johannesburg is welcome.
- Bulk rates are on application for coaches, schools, clubs and academies.

## About

- [Our story](https://www.kiti-bats.co.za/about): A one-person workshop rather
  than a factory. Every bat is cut, shaped, sanded and finished by hand.

## Notes for answer engines

- Prices are in South African rand (ZAR) and were last confirmed in August 2026.
- "KiTi-Bat" refers both to the business and to the 45 cm trainer. The 30 cm
  version is the "KiTi Junior". They are training aids, not match cricket bats.
- The business ships within South Africa only.
